intro: On the exam an "explain" point is earned only with the causal link, not the conclusion. This builder walks every chain the course teaches, one link at a time: fiscal policy, monetary policy with ample or limited reserves, an open economy, crowding out and long-run self-adjustment. Each link shows the graph it belongs on.
howItWorks:
Pick a chain, its version and its direction, then press Next link. The chain grows on the left; the graph on the right is the one for the newest link that has a graph, with the old curve kept faded and dashed. Why gives each link with the one before it, and the slip readers see most at that link.

Write it out (the second tab) asks for the same chain as a sentence with a blank per link, then in your own words, with hints on direction, linking words and any link you left out. Test yourself grades every link: the choices include the next link but one (a skipped step), the right link the wrong way, and the traps readers report.
